curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Introduce the three escape options and correct ABS braking.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on braking, ABS pressure and steering with ABS.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on ABS technique and the three options.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain swerving, accelerating out of danger and skid recovery.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on swerve steps, acceleration and skids.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on what to do in a skid.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover pavement drop-offs, warning lights and brake failure steps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on drop-off recovery and the brake failure order.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items that separate panic steering from gentle recovery.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain blowout behavior and response, then engine failure.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on front and rear blowouts and engine failure steps.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on braking after a blowout versus an engine failure.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover a stuck accelerator, breakdown warnings and SCDMV emergency contacts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the stuck pedal order, flares and emergency contacts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on flare distance and breakdown steps.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec12-m01..sec12-m05; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
